roots.name: Birds and Birdwatching
roots.anchor_definition: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

roots.name: Mammals and Wildlife
roots.anchor_definition: any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk

roots.name: Fish and Aquatic Vertebrates
roots.anchor_definition: any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills

roots.name: Insects and Entomology
roots.anchor_definition: small air-breathing arthropod

roots.name: Reptiles
roots.anchor_definition: any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises, turtles, snakes, lizards, alligators, crocodiles, and extinct forms

roots.name: Amphibians
roots.anchor_definition: cold-blooded vertebrate typically living on land but breeding in water; aquatic larvae undergo metamorphosis into adult form

roots.name: Mollusks and Shells
roots.anchor_definition: invertebrate having a soft unsegmented body usually enclosed in a shell

roots.name: Crustaceans
roots.anchor_definition: any mainly aquatic arthropod usually having a segmented body and chitinous exoskeleton

roots.name: Arachnids
roots.anchor_definition: air-breathing arthropods characterized by simple eyes and four pairs of legs

roots.name: Worms and Small Invertebrates
roots.anchor_definition: any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae

roots.name: Horses and Equine Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

roots.name: Dogs and Canine Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

roots.name: Cats and Feline Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats

roots.name: Cattle and Livestock
roots.anchor_definition: domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age

roots.name: Sheep and Wool Farming
roots.anchor_definition: woolly usually horned ruminant mammal related to the goat

roots.name: Goats
roots.anchor_definition: any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns

roots.name: Poultry
roots.anchor_definition: a domesticated gallinaceous bird thought to be descended from the red jungle fowl

roots.name: Butterflies
roots.anchor_definition: diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings

roots.name: Moths
roots.anchor_definition: typically crepuscular or nocturnal insect having a stout body and feathery or hairlike antennae

roots.name: Beetles
roots.anchor_definition: insect having biting mouthparts and front wings modified to form horny covers overlying the membranous rear wings

roots.name: Bees
roots.anchor_definition: any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species

roots.name: Ants
roots.anchor_definition: social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers

roots.name: Snakes
roots.anchor_definition: limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous

roots.name: Lizards
roots.anchor_definition: relatively long-bodied reptile with usually two pairs of legs and a tapering tail

roots.name: Turtles
roots.anchor_definition: any of various aquatic and land reptiles having a bony shell and flipper-like limbs for swimming

roots.name: Frogs and Toads
roots.anchor_definition: any of various tailless stout-bodied amphibians with long hind limbs for leaping; semiaquatic and terrestrial species

roots.name: Plants and Botany
roots.anchor_definition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion

roots.name: Flowers and Flowering Plants
roots.anchor_definition: a plant cultivated for its blooms or blossoms

roots.name: Trees and Dendrology
roots.anchor_definition: a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms

roots.name: Shrubs and Bushes
roots.anchor_definition: a low woody perennial plant usually having several major stems

roots.name: Herbaceous Plants
roots.anchor_definition: a plant lacking a permanent woody stem; many are flowering garden plants or potherbs; some having medicinal properties; some are pests

roots.name: Ferns
roots.anchor_definition: any of numerous flowerless and seedless vascular plants having true roots from a rhizome and fronds that uncurl upward; reproduce by spores

roots.name: Grasses
roots.anchor_definition: narrow-leaved green herbage: grown as lawns; used as pasture for grazing animals; cut and dried as hay

roots.name: Mosses
roots.anchor_definition: tiny leafy-stemmed flowerless plants

roots.name: Algae
roots.anchor_definition: primitive chlorophyll-containing mainly aquatic eukaryotic organisms lacking true stems and roots and leaves

roots.name: Fungi and Mycology
roots.anchor_definition: an organism of the kingdom Fungi lacking chlorophyll and feeding on organic matter; ranging from unicellular or multicellular organisms to spore-bearing syncytia

roots.name: Leaves and Plant Anatomy
roots.anchor_definition: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants

roots.name: Roots and Root Systems
roots.anchor_definition: (botany) the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves or nodes; absorbs water and mineral salts; usually it anchors the plant to the ground

roots.name: Fruits and Botanical Structures
roots.anchor_definition: the ripened reproductive body of a seed plant

roots.name: Vegetables
roots.anchor_definition: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

roots.name: Food and Ingredients
roots.anchor_definition: any substance that can be metabolized by an animal to give energy and build tissue

roots.name: Beverages
roots.anchor_definition: any liquid suitable for drinking

roots.name: Breads and Rolls
roots.anchor_definition: food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked

roots.name: Cakes and Baking
roots.anchor_definition: baked goods made from or based on a mixture of flour, sugar, eggs, and fat

roots.name: Pastries
roots.anchor_definition: any of various baked foods made of dough or batter

roots.name: Cheeses
roots.anchor_definition: a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk

roots.name: Culinary Herbs
roots.anchor_definition: aromatic potherb used in cookery for its savory qualities

roots.name: Spices
roots.anchor_definition: any of a variety of pungent aromatic vegetable substances used for flavoring food

roots.name: Condiments and Sauces
roots.anchor_definition: a preparation (a sauce or relish or spice) to enhance flavor or enjoyment

roots.name: Desserts
roots.anchor_definition: a dish served as the last course of a meal

roots.name: Grains and Cereals
roots.anchor_definition: foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses

roots.name: Nuts and Seeds
roots.anchor_definition: usually large hard-shelled seed

roots.name: Soups
roots.anchor_definition: liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food

roots.name: Sandwiches
roots.anchor_definition: two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them

roots.name: Meat and Cuts
roots.anchor_definition: the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food

roots.name: Seafood as Food
roots.anchor_definition: edible fish (broadly including freshwater fish) or shellfish or roe etc

roots.name: Coffee
roots.anchor_definition: a beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans

roots.name: Tea
roots.anchor_definition: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water

roots.name: Wine Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: fermented juice (of grapes especially)

roots.name: Beer Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops

roots.name: Liquor Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented

roots.name: Cooking Methods
roots.anchor_definition: the act of preparing something (as food) by the application of heat

roots.name: Tools and Workshop Equipment
roots.anchor_definition: an implement used in the practice of a vocation

roots.name: Household Utensils
roots.anchor_definition: an implement for practical use (especially in a household)

roots.name: Kitchenware
roots.anchor_definition: hardware utensils for use in a kitchen

roots.name: Cutlery
roots.anchor_definition: a cutting implement; a tool for cutting

roots.name: Household Appliances
roots.anchor_definition: an appliance that does a particular job in the home

roots.name: Furniture
roots.anchor_definition: furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy

roots.name: Bedding
roots.anchor_definition: coverings that are used on a bed

roots.name: Clothing and Apparel
roots.anchor_definition: a covering designed to be worn on a person's body

roots.name: Textiles and Fabrics
roots.anchor_definition: artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers

roots.name: Footwear
roots.anchor_definition: clothing worn on a person's feet

roots.name: Headgear
roots.anchor_definition: clothing for the head

roots.name: Jewelry and Adornment
roots.anchor_definition: an adornment (as a bracelet or ring or necklace) made of precious metals and set with gems (or imitation gems)

roots.name: Containers and Storage
roots.anchor_definition: any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)

roots.name: Mechanical Fasteners
roots.anchor_definition: restraint that attaches to something or holds something in place

roots.name: Machines and Mechanisms
roots.anchor_definition: any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks

roots.name: Musical Instruments
roots.anchor_definition: any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds

roots.name: Music and Musical Forms
roots.anchor_definition: an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner

roots.name: Songs
roots.anchor_definition: a short musical composition with words

roots.name: Dance
roots.anchor_definition: an artistic form of nonverbal communication

roots.name: Sports and Athletics
roots.anchor_definition: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition

roots.name: Games and Play
roots.anchor_definition: a contest with rules to determine a winner

roots.name: Recreation and Pastimes
roots.anchor_definition: an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates

roots.name: Physical Exercise
roots.anchor_definition: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit

roots.name: Buildings and Architecture
roots.anchor_definition: a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place

roots.name: Rooms and Interior Spaces
roots.anchor_definition: an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling

roots.name: Vehicles and Transport
roots.anchor_definition: a conveyance that transports people or objects

roots.name: Watercraft and Boats
roots.anchor_definition: a craft designed for water transportation

roots.name: Aircraft
roots.anchor_definition: a vehicle that can fly

roots.name: Spacecraft
roots.anchor_definition: a craft capable of traveling in outer space; technically, a satellite around the sun

roots.name: Motor Vehicles
roots.anchor_definition: a self-propelled wheeled vehicle that does not run on rails

roots.name: Bicycles
roots.anchor_definition: a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals

roots.name: Motorcycles
roots.anchor_definition: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame

roots.name: Trucks
roots.anchor_definition: an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling

roots.name: Cars
roots.anchor_definition: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

roots.name: Artworks and Visual Art
roots.anchor_definition: the products of human creativity; works of art collectively

roots.name: Artistic Creation
roots.anchor_definition: the creation of beautiful or significant things

roots.name: Crafts and Skilled Trades
roots.anchor_definition: the skilled practice of a practical occupation

roots.name: Needlework
roots.anchor_definition: a creation created or assembled by needle and thread

roots.name: Painting
roots.anchor_definition: graphic art consisting of an artistic composition made by applying paints to a surface

roots.name: Sculpture
roots.anchor_definition: a three-dimensional work of plastic art

roots.name: Photography
roots.anchor_definition: the act of taking and printing photographs

roots.name: Drawing
roots.anchor_definition: an illustration that is drawn by hand and published in a book, magazine, or newspaper

roots.name: Pottery
roots.anchor_definition: ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln

roots.name: Occupations and Work
roots.anchor_definition: the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money

roots.name: Workers and Trades
roots.anchor_definition: a person who works at a specific occupation

roots.name: Skilled Workers
roots.anchor_definition: a worker who has acquired special skills

roots.name: Educators
roots.anchor_definition: someone who educates young people

roots.name: Scientists
roots.anchor_definition: a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences

roots.name: Artists
roots.anchor_definition: a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination

roots.name: Musicians
roots.anchor_definition: someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)

roots.name: Writers
roots.anchor_definition: writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)

roots.name: Athletes
roots.anchor_definition: a person trained to compete in sports

roots.name: Merchants and Retail
roots.anchor_definition: a businessperson engaged in retail trade

roots.name: Organizations and Community
roots.anchor_definition: a group of people who work together

roots.name: Institutions
roots.anchor_definition: an organization founded and united for a specific purpose

roots.name: Education and Instruction
roots.anchor_definition: the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill

roots.name: Fields of Science
roots.anchor_definition: a particular branch of scientific knowledge

roots.name: Geology
roots.anchor_definition: a science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks

roots.name: Astronomy
roots.anchor_definition: the branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole

roots.name: Minerals and Mineralogy
roots.anchor_definition: solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition

roots.name: Rock Types
roots.anchor_definition: material consisting of the aggregate of minerals like those making up the Earth's crust

roots.name: Gemstones and Lapidary
roots.anchor_definition: a crystalline rock that can be cut and polished for jewelry

roots.name: Metals and Elements
roots.anchor_definition: any of several chemical elements that are usually shiny solids that conduct heat or electricity and can be formed into sheets etc.

roots.name: Alloys
roots.anchor_definition: a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten

roots.name: Wood and Timber
roots.anchor_definition: the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees

roots.name: Leather
roots.anchor_definition: an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning

roots.name: Glass Materials
roots.anchor_definition: a brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure

roots.name: Weather and Atmospheric Conditions
roots.anchor_definition: the atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation

roots.name: Celestial Bodies
roots.anchor_definition: natural objects visible in the sky

roots.name: Geological Formations
roots.anchor_definition: (geology) the geological features of the earth

roots.name: Mountains and Highlands
roots.anchor_definition: a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill

roots.name: Rivers and Waterways
roots.anchor_definition: a large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)

roots.name: Lakes
roots.anchor_definition: a body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land

roots.name: Wetlands
roots.anchor_definition: a low area where the land is saturated with water

roots.name: Forests and Woodlands
roots.anchor_definition: the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area

roots.name: Deserts
roots.anchor_definition: arid land with little or no vegetation

roots.name: Optical Instruments
roots.anchor_definition: an instrument designed to aid vision

roots.name: Electrical Devices
roots.anchor_definition: a device that produces or is powered by electricity

roots.name: Electronic Devices
roots.anchor_definition: a device that accomplishes its purpose electronically

roots.name: Computers
roots.anchor_definition: a machine for performing calculations automatically

roots.name: Software Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory

roots.name: Mathematics
roots.anchor_definition: a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement

roots.name: Geometry
roots.anchor_definition: the pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces

roots.name: Measurements and Units
roots.anchor_definition: any division of quantity accepted as a standard of measurement or exchange

roots.name: Clocks and Timepieces
roots.anchor_definition: a measuring instrument or device for keeping time

roots.name: Books and Written Works
roots.anchor_definition: a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)

roots.name: Physical Books and Binding
roots.anchor_definition: physical objects consisting of a number of pages bound together

roots.name: Literature and Writing
roots.anchor_definition: the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect)

roots.name: Poetry
roots.anchor_definition: literature in metrical form

roots.name: Prose
roots.anchor_definition: ordinary writing as distinguished from verse

roots.name: Grammar
roots.anchor_definition: the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics)

roots.name: Punctuation
roots.anchor_definition: the marks used to clarify meaning by indicating separation of words into sentences and clauses and phrases

roots.name: Words and Linguistic Forms
roots.anchor_definition: a unit of language that native speakers can identify

roots.name: Figures of Speech
roots.anchor_definition: language used in a figurative or nonliteral sense

roots.name: Colors and Hues
roots.anchor_definition: a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect

roots.name: Geometric Shapes
roots.anchor_definition: the spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance

roots.name: Feelings and Emotional Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: the experiencing of affective and emotional states

roots.name: Personality Vocabulary
roots.anchor_definition: the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual

roots.name: Ceremonies and Celebrations
roots.anchor_definition: a formal event performed on a special occasion

roots.name: Celebrations
roots.anchor_definition: any joyous diversion

roots.name: Festivals and Performance Events
roots.anchor_definition: an organized series of acts and performances (usually in one place)

roots.name: Railways and Trains
roots.anchor_definition: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

roots.name: Ships and Seafaring
roots.anchor_definition: a vessel that carries passengers or freight

roots.name: Islands and Coastal Landforms
roots.anchor_definition: a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water

roots.name: Chemical Elements
roots.anchor_definition: any of the more than 100 known substances (of which 92 occur naturally) that cannot be separated into simpler substances and that singly or in combination constitute all matter

roots.name: Numbers and Counting
roots.anchor_definition: a concept of quantity involving zero and units

roots.name: Calendars and Timekeeping
roots.anchor_definition: a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year

roots.name: Paper and Papermaking
roots.anchor_definition: a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses

roots.name: Plastics and Materials
roots.anchor_definition: generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives
